dedupe_keys.name: ouvrages d assainissement sur rennes metropole

description: Ouvrages d'assainissement sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche localise de manière schématique les ouvrages d'assainissement sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are station d'épuration des eaux usées, assainissement collectif, ouvrage d'art. The portal shows 1,647 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
